name: changelog-page
title: Changelog page
description: The changelog template, built only from library items: every release newest first under a hairline, its date in capitals on the left, the change as a Funnel Display sentence, its details and a picture when there is one.
use_for: A website's changelog. The entries are examples drawn from what the assets say the product does, and their dates are placeholders: replace them in lib/pages/changelog.ts.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a section
A release date that is not real
source: Built from the library (site header, creative card, footer row); the entries' sentences are the posts' own lines

import { CreativeCard } from '@/react/components/site/CreativeCard' import { FooterRow } from '@/react/components/site/FooterRow' import { SiteHeader } from '@/react/components/site/SiteHeader' import { changelogContent, type ChangelogContent } from '@/lib/pages/changelog' import { cn } from '@/react/lib/cn' // The changelog from library items: the title, then every release newest first under a hairline, its date in // capitals on the left (it stays in view while the entry scrolls on wide screens), the change as a Funnel Display // sentence, a line, the details and a picture when there is one. `content` replaces the entries // (lib/pages/changelog.ts). export interface ChangelogPageProps { content?: ChangelogContent className?: string } const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' export function ChangelogPage({ content: c = changelogContent, className }: ChangelogPageProps) { return (

{c.title}

{c.body}

    {c.entries.map((e) => (

  1. {e.date}

    {e.title}

    {e.body}

    {e.items.length > 0 &&
      {e.items.map((i) =>
    • {i}
      • )}
    } {e.image && }
    2. ))}
) } export default ChangelogPage

import { html, nothing } from 'lit' import { DsElement, define, HostLayoutController } from '@/elements/lib/element' import { changelogContent, type ChangelogContent } from '@/lib/pages/changelog' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-card' import '@/elements/components/site/footer-row' import '@/elements/components/site/site-header' import styles from 'virtual:tw' // ChangelogPage.tsx as : every release newest first, its date on the left, the change, its // details and a picture when there is one. `content` replaces the entries. const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' /** * @summary The changelog template. */ export class ChangelogPage extends DsElement { static styles = [DsElement.styles, styles] protected readonly layout = new HostLayoutController(this, () => this.renderRoot.querySelector('[data-ds="changelog-page"]')) static properties = { content: { type: Object } } /** The entries (lib/pages/changelog.ts by default). */ content: ChangelogContent = changelogContent render() { const c = this.content ?? changelogContent return html`

${c.title}

${c.body}

    ${c.entries.map((e) => html`

  1. ${e.date}

    ${e.title}

    ${e.body}

    ${e.items.length ? html`
      ${e.items.map((i) => html`
    • ${i}
      • `)}
    ` : nothing}${e.image ? html`` : nothing}
    2. `)}
` } } define('changelog-page', ChangelogPage)
